details.biography:
Ali Greene began her journey as a Production Coordinator at Industrial Light & Magic (ILM) in the fall of 2015. Through dedication and passion for visual storytelling, she rose through the ranks to become a producer, with her recent work spanning various high-profile Marvel projects.

Originally from Rossland, British Columbia, Ali earned an Honors Specialization in Consumer Behavior from the University of Western Ontario. Shortly after graduating, her enthusiasm for film guided her into Visual Effects.

Her first project at ILM was Deepwater Horizon, and she has since contributed to an impressive roster of feature films and streaming series, including Hawkeye, Loki, Eternals, Black Widow, Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Academy Award® nominee), Aladdin, and Kong: Skull Island.
details.name: Alexandra Greene
